findings.description: Argument.get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) without converting a None help to an empty string, so an undocumented argument produces a None description in the row list.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one argument that has help text and another positional argument with no help. format_help_text's guard passes because any arg has help, so write_dl receives a row whose second element is None. The formatter's width measurement calls term_len on every cell, and term_len on None raises TypeError. Impact: `--help` crashes for any command that mixes documented and undocumented positional arguments, which is a common case.
